profile.headline: Software Engineer at MIT
profile.summary:
Software Engineer with a track record of delivering at every stage of the Software Development Lifecycle. Perform technical leadership and individual contributor roles in a fast-paced environment. Seed next-generation products and features through innovation projects.

Proficiencies: Distributed Systems, Software Engineering and SDLC, C/C++, Java, Python, Linux, OO Methodologies, SDDC and HCI,  performance, REST, XML, SQL, Tech Leadership, Agile/Scrum, Rally, Innovation.

positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.description:
Languages: C++, Python, Java
Technologies: AI/ML, Distributed/Parallel computing, ETL, MLOps, DevSecOps, Embedded/SBC
Tools: Docker, VMware, MLFlow, SQL/NoSQL, Linux, Elastic Search, NiFi, X509/PKI, Jira
positions.insights: Distributed Systems, Python (Programming Language) and +4 skills

positions.title: Staff Software Engineer II
positions.description:
Product: vSAN extensions.  Discover, Protect, and Recover virtualized multi-VM applications using app-native tools in a multi-tenant environment.
Role: Individual Contributor and Tech Lead of Application Awareness extensions.
Technologies: C/C++, Python, Powershell, VIM API, Rally

3 Innovation Projects presented at annual R&D Innovation Offsite.  Prototypes, presentations, and papers submitted/presented.
Technologies:  Java, JavaScript, Apache, VIM API, SRM/HA/FT
Patent: US20150378758 A1: “Processing Virtual Machine Objects through Multistep Workflows”

positions.title: Senior MTS
positions.description:
Product: Site Recovery Manager (SRM): Disaster Recovery and Mobility for virtualized workloads.  Orchestrate Compute, Storage, and Network mobility for DR/Test workflows.
Role: Senior member of core dev team that architected, designed, and implemented SRM.
Technologies: C/C++, SQL/ODBC (Postgres, SQL Server, Oracle, DB2), VIM API, Rally.

Product: VMware Importer/Converter: Convert VMs to/from multiple formats.
Role: Senior member of dev team.
Technologies: C++, win32, VIM API

2 Innovation Projects presented at annual R&D Innovation Offsite.  Prototypes, presentations, and papers submitted.
Technologies: Java, Javascript, Apache, VIM+SRM API, Linux, Postgres, VMware Studio.
